IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  CRIMINAL REVISION APPLICATION NO. 420 of 2017  ============================================================
 ===
 TAHER IBRAHIM TAJMAHAL....Applicant(s)
 Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & 1....Respondent(s)
 ===============================================================
 Appearance:

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  CRIMINAL REVISION
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: MR UTPAL M PANCHAL, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MR NJ SHAH APP for the Respondent(s) No
Learned APP waives service of notice of rule on behalf of respondent State.

2. In the main Criminal Revision Application, the applicant herein original accused has prayed to release him on bail by suspending the sentence imposed by the learned 11th Additional Sessions Judge, Surat, vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No.20 of 2005 dated 28.4.2017,
whereby the learned Sessions Judge has confirmed the judgment and order passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Municipal Court, Surat, in P.F.A. Case No.3 of 1998 dated 3.5.2005,
whereby learned trial Judge has convicted and sentenced the applicant for the offence punishable under Sections 7(1) (5) and 16(1)(a)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
3.
Learned advocate Mr. Utpal Panchal for the applicant states that the impugned judgment and order passed by the HC-NIC Page 1 of 3 Created On Wed May 03 00:51:59 IST 2017 R/CR.RA/420/2017 ORDER
Courts below are required to be set aside as the same are passed without properly appreciating the evidence on record and the Courts below imposed such harsh imprisonment.
He, therefore, prays to grant the bail to the applicant by suspending the sentence till disposal of the present Revision Application.
4. Heard learned APP appearing for the respondent State.
